name: Mark III - Motion Training Set
notes: Interview case-study sources, not studio-authorized production assets. Video source is a user-selected enhanced YouTube upload; its 8K label does not establish native detail. Existing source overlay and thin borders are retained. Training clips are center-trimmed to 22 or 39 frames at 24 fps, with no optical-flow interpolation or audio. Three adjacent dodge/fire/walk-away clips are reserved and never uploaded for training. This is a sequence holdout within the same film and setting, not an independent pretraining-contamination test. Nine stills supplement detail and pose coverage; near-duplicate film frames were omitted. No generated media are training targets. H3 hosted license coverage remains unverified; user instructed proceeding on 2026-09-08.

items.title: Flight Lateral Bank
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor. A red and gold metallic armored suit flies horizontally above clouds; the camera follows its lateral pass, with bright boot exhaust behind it.

items.title: Hero Landing
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit with a circular chest light, settles into a low landing crouch in a sunlit damaged street. Dust rises; a person partially occupies the foreground.

items.title: Hero Rise
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit with a closed helmet and circular chest light, rises from a crouch as the camera moves closer in a sunlit damaged street.

items.title: Punch And Turn
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor. A red and gold metallic armored suit swings an armored arm toward an armed man in a damaged sunlit village street. The camera moves with the fast upper-body action.

items.title: Repulsor Side Turn
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor pivots through a side and rear view, extending an armored palm to fire a bright repulsor blast in a damaged village street. Red and gold rigid plates, circular chest light, moving camera.

items.title: Repulsor Rear
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor viewed from behind raises and aims an armored palm, firing a bright repulsor blast toward a distant wall. Red and gold back plates, sunlit damaged street, brief flashes.

items.title: Palms Raised
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, closed gold helmet and circular chest light, raises both open armored palms toward the camera. The palm emitters glow brightly; close frontal view in a sunlit damaged street.

items.title: Abort Lower Arms
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor holds both palms forward then lowers its arms without firing. Frontal medium-wide view, red and gold metallic armor and circular chest light, damaged street and mountains behind.

items.title: Hands Power Down
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor. Close rear view at waist level of articulated red and gold armored hands relaxing beside the hips. A small palm light remains visible; people stand in the background.

items.title: Shoulder Retract
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor. A red and gold metallic armored suit stands with arms lowered, with slight upper-body movement. Closed gold faceplate, circular illuminated chest reactor, damaged sunlit village street.

items.title: Wall Pull
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor pulls a man through a damaged wall, seen from a rear three-quarter view. Red and gold rigid armor, fast arm and body motion, masonry and dust.

items.title: Takeoff Front
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor initiates vertical takeoff with arms lowered, bright palm and boot exhaust, in front of a damaged wall in daylight.

items.title: Hover Rear Turn
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor hovers above a street and turns its closed helmet toward the camera. Close rear three-quarter view of red and gold back and shoulder plates, with people below.

items.title: Rear Stance
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor stands with its back toward the camera in a rubble-strewn village street, slight body movement, red and gold back plates visible, smoke in the distance.

items.title: Dodge And Wrist Fire
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor makes a quick evasive upper-body movement, raises one forearm, and fires a small wrist-mounted projectile. Low-angle medium view of red and gold armor with a circular chest light against buildings and smoke.

items.title: Turn And Walk Away
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor turns and walks toward the camera as an explosion rises behind it in a damaged village street. Closed gold helmet, circular white chest light, red and gold metallic plates.

items.title: Final Takeoff Wide
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor stands in a damaged street, ignites bright palm and boot thrusters, and lifts vertically out of the frame, kicking up dust; people partially frame the foreground.

items.title: 60a
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, close-up frontal portrait of the helmet and upper chest, head tilted slightly downward, gold faceplate with illuminated white eye slits, red metallic shoulder and chest plates with visible scuffs, glowing circular chest reactor partly cropped at the bottom, softly blurred indoor background.

items.title: 60b
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, full-body three-quarter standing portrait, red and gold metallic plates, closed helmet with illuminated white eyes and a glowing circular chest reactor, arms relaxed at the sides with clenched hands, both armored boots visible, dramatic studio lighting against a dark smoky gray background.

items.title: 61b
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, full-body three-point landing pose with one armored fist planted on the ground, one knee bent low and the opposite arm raised behind the shoulder, red and gold metallic plates, closed helmet angled downward, illuminated eyes and circular chest reactor, textured ground and a smoky gray studio background.

items.title: movie5
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, ground-level close-up of the backs of the lower legs and armored boots, standing on dusty rubble, upper body outside the frame, scratched and dusty surfaces, daylight with broken masonry in the background.

items.title: movie10
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, extreme close-up of the illuminated circular chest reactor and surrounding chest plate, head and limbs outside the frame, concentric luminous rings and a fine central grille, glossy reflections in dim indoor lighting.

items.title: movie11
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, straight-on close-up portrait of the closed helmet and upper shoulders, faceplate looking toward the camera, subtle scratches and metallic reflections, glowing eye slits, dim workshop background with blurred blue monitors and warm lights.

items.title: movie14
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, close-up rear-side detail of the hip, upper thigh, and lowered forearm and hand, head and most of the body outside the frame, scratched and dusty metal panels, subdued daylight with out-of-focus people and a damaged street behind.

items.title: movie16
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, extreme close-up of the closed helmet in a near-frontal view, top of the helmet and lower neck cropped by the frame, fine surface scuffs and glowing eye slits, soft daylight, blurred blue-gray background.

items.title: movie7
items.caption: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] IMK3GIK armor, a red and gold metallic armored suit, full-body flight view approaching the camera at a slight angle, body held horizontally with arms swept back and legs trailing behind, closed helmet, bright boot exhaust, pale blue sky and white clouds, soft motion detail.
